cta.label: Free · 15 minutes · no obligation
cta.title: Start with a free 15-minute call
cta.text: Tell me why you want to learn. By the end of the call you know your level, the format that fits your week and what the first month looks like. Then you decide.
cta.fine: One teacher means a limited number of students. If my week is full, I’ll tell you when the next place opens.

rhythm: I suggest two hours a week. Enough to make real progress, light enough to keep up.

formats.title: Just you, or a small group?

options.title: One-on-one
options.text: The whole lesson is built around you: your goals and your pace.

options.title: Small group
options.text: You practice with each other, and the lesson stays personal.

options.title: In person
options.text: At my place, or at your home for an additional fee. Somewhere quiet, not a noisy cafe.

options.title: Online
options.text: Same lessons, on video. Good when you are short on time or outside the Atlanta area.

formatsNote: Any mix works: one-on-one online, a small group in person, or the other way round.
levelsText: Every Italian, Spanish and French lesson is matched to your level and your age. Italian and Spanish run from beginner to business level. French is for beginners. Not sure where you stand? The [free 15-minute call](#contact) sorts that out.

levels.title: Beginners
levels.text: You start from zero, or from a few words you already know.

levels.title: Intermediate
levels.text: You get by. Now you build real conversation.

levels.title: Advanced
levels.text: Fluency, nuance and the culture behind the words.

levels.title: Business
levels.text: Meetings, calls and email in the language you work in.

ages.title: Adults
ages.text: For work, travel, family or the pleasure of it.

ages.title: Teens
ages.text: Alongside school, at their own pace.

ages.title: Kids
ages.text: Lessons built around their age and what they like.

reviews.quote: Valentina is a wonderful teacher. She is very organized, well prepared, and specifically tailors the lessons to my learning goals. She challenges me while being very supportive and encouraging. I really enjoy my lessons with Valentina, and I highly recommend her.
reviews.name: Patricia

reviews.quote: The students absolutely loved the class and had such a great time learning with you. We really appreciated your energy, flexibility, and the way you engaged them throughout the lesson.
reviews.name: Dr. Aleli Vazquez
reviews.detail: Dean of Faculty, Ron Clark Academy

reviews.quote: Valentina Songia is a very effective teacher. She’s patient and supportive. I feel confident practicing my español by ordering in restaurants and greeting others. She meets us where we are in our progress and doesn’t judge. I look forward to our class each week.
reviews.name: Felicia

reviews.quote: Valentina explains how to use the language in context and helps us understand the topic. When we do not understand something, she is patient and breaks down the material. I have really enjoyed learning from her.
reviews.name: Stella

reviews.quote: I’ve really enjoyed taking in-person Italian lessons with Valentina Songia, who is an excellent teacher and incredibly patient. My goal is to become more confident speaking Italian and more comfortable interacting with locals when traveling in Italy, and Valentina has made learning both enjoyable and rewarding. I strongly believe that personalized, face-to-face instruction is far more effective than language apps or online courses, and I highly recommend Valentina to anyone interested in learning Italian.
reviews.name: Bill

reviews.quote: Her enthusiasm has delighted our students and made her a pleasure to work with. With no hesitation, we recommend Valentina as a language instructor.
reviews.name: Catherine Geller
